en-US.author: A Must in Every Office BV
en-US.copyright: ©1999-2026 ∙ ASAP Utilities ∙ A Must in Every Office BV ∙ The Netherlands
en-US.description: A friendly Excel add-in that saves our users a lot of valuable time.
en-US.longDescription: ASAP Utilities is a friendly Excel add-in that saves our users a lot of valuable time. It contains many well-thought-out and useful tools that make working in Excel much easier and faster.
en-US.name: ASAP Utilities (Home and Student edition)
en-US.publisher: A Must in Every Office BV - Bastien Mensink
en-US.releaseNotes:
We're happy to announce that version 9.4 is now available for download!
- This update focuses on making ASAP Utilities easier to get started with and helping you discover more of its useful features.
- We've improved the installer with a friendlier welcome and easier access to helpful information. After installation, you can open our Start Here page in your own language to discover how to begin using ASAP Utilities in Excel.
- We've also added "Browse All Tool Descriptions..." to the ASAP Utilities Options menu. This makes it easier to explore the available tools directly in Excel and discover useful features you might not have tried before.
- In addition, we've improved selected translations in the Ribbon and other parts of the interface. We're gradually reviewing and improving the translations across all supported languages.
- Version 9.4 also includes several small improvements and fixes.
We invite you to download and try version 9.4!
- Download version 9.3
- See what's new and improved
Thank you for using ASAP Utilities and for the feedback that helps us continue improving it.
With great enthusiasm,
The ASAP Utilities Team
